sharpenedCases.before: Published after the start and consumed it, which an unpurged queue does as well.
sharpenedCases.now: Leaves a message in the queue before the start and asserts the consumer never saw it. A delivery count of zero alone was not enough: a consumer that ate the message leaves the same zero, and the first version of this case passed with purging disabled.

sharpenedCases.before: A two minute consumer under the one minute default lock, asserting only that something had been consumed, which a redelivered duplicate satisfies.
sharpenedCases.now: Four second lock, consumer held across three of them, asserting that the lock expiry moved, that the consumer was entered exactly once and that the delivery left the queue.
